ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 80% of the visible fluke, with high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the distal tips and in specific circular focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region occupying the central and medial fluke surface. High-intensity white patches mapped to the distal lobe tips (left and right). Discrete circular white spots (rosettes) distributed at [left-medial, right-medial, right-distal] coordinates.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Multiple deep pixel-valleys (notches) and peaks visible along the entire upper boundary, particularly prominent on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex upward sweep terminating in tapered, irregular distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least six distinct high-intensity circular rings distributed across the dark pigment; three clustered on the right lobe and three scattered on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the right lobe at diagonal orientations relative to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge degradation consistent with physical trauma or predation; multiple circular barnacle attachment scars visible as high-contrast rings.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, multi-notched profile on the trailing edge of the left lobe distal tip compared to the relatively smoother right distal edge.
